$comment: Curated matches between our catalog ids and free-exercise-db names. confidence: high = same movement (photos used); doubtful = similar but not the same (NOT used unless the id is in 'approved'); none = no good visual. Ids not listed here are matched automatically by name (exact = high, similar = doubtful).
